outcome: Consolidate one banking or travel support team into a measured service queue, automate routing and case chasing, and hand over accepted workflows and dashboards.
overview: Give support leaders one accountable queue with clear ownership, response deadlines and measurable resolution performance. The proposed engagement connects one customer-support team, two approved intake channels and one CRM or booking-system integration. Deliverables include tested routing rules, an escalation matrix, a usable knowledge base and an operational dashboard.
kpi: Median and 90th-percentile resolution time, first-response SLA attainment, reopen rate and customer satisfaction.
scope: Planning estimate: four to six weeks for one team, two channels and one integration after access approval. Sequence: baseline and design, configuration, data import rehearsal, integration testing, pilot operation, acceptance and administrator handover. Scope includes five routing or escalation workflows and ten starter knowledge articles. Additional brands, systems or historical migrations require a revised estimate. Existing service benchmark: Freshworks Onboarding Packages, covering onboarding guidance and administrator training [CX-FW-PS].

prerequisites: Agreed access for the service team
A current inventory of what is covered
